messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up: candidate Nadia Ruiz (Senior Infra) visiting 2026-07-21. Flight lands 08:20 local, onsite loop 11:00-15:30. Needs: vegan lunch, private quiet room for neurodiversity accommodation (30-minute wind-down), breastfeeding-friendly space, and a USB-C dongle loaner. Also requesting accessible restroom location. Can we confirm badge, parking, and welcome escort?
Ben Howard: I'll reserve the private room (Quiet Pod B) 10:30-12:00 for the wind-down and Quiet Pod A for the pairing task. Where should lunch be served?
Aisha Khan: Lunch at 12:45 in the ground-floor lounge table near reception. Order vegan + nut-free. Panel is 5 people, so cater for 6.
Tara Li: Badge provisioning noted. Name to print?
Recruiter Sam: "Nadia Ruiz" as on passport. Sam: I've reconfirmed itinerary and accommodation requests with Nadia this morning. She prefers an escort to the restroom if stairs are tricky.
Mike Reynolds: Travel stipend: I've emailed Nadia the expense form and sent the payment link. Will chase receipts after the visit.
PeopleOps Bot: Checklist created: badge, parking, loaner dongle, quiet room, lactation room. Accessibility note pinned. :white_check_mark:
Ben Howard: USB-C dongle (asset DGL-07) available. I'll tag it and leave it at Front Desk in envelope labeled "Nadia Ruiz - dongle".
Tara Li: Badge & escort: I'll pre-create an all-day visitor badge and add temporary door access to Quiet Pods. Badge at front desk by 08:45. Front Desk will ask for photo ID on pickup.
Facilities: Parking pass for Visitor Lot L1-03 reserved 07:30-19:00. Lactation room keycode set to 7312 for that day; we'll tape signage to the hallway. Accessibility map updated at main entrance.
Security: Reminder: all visitors need to sign NDA if they enter secure labs. Nadia flagged that she will not access secure labs, only interview rooms. Still prepare visitor NDA form at front desk in case.
Aisha Khan: Good catch, Security. Nadia will only be in public rooms. Please still have the NDA packet available just in case.
Ben Howard: Calendar tweak: moved first pairing session to 11:15 start to give Nadia time to clear customs and relax. Updated invites and sent new ICS to Nadia and interviewers.
Recruiter Sam: Remote backup: if arrival delayed >45m we switch the 11:15 pairing to remote. Sam will confirm panelist availability. Zoom link included in invite.
Tara Li: Locker note: we'll place dongle and spare charger in envelope with badge. Locker #B7 for small items if Nadia prefers to store personal bag.
Mike Reynolds: I'll monitor her flight (AX-980). PeopleOps Bot, please post arrival and gate alerts here.
PeopleOps Bot: Flight AX-980 status: scheduled. Will post updates and any gate changes to thread.
Aisha Khan: Who will greet at lobby? I can be there but I'm on a different terminal.
Ben Howard: I can meet at 08:50 and escort to front desk. If I get pulled into an incident, Tara will step in.
Tara Li: Acknowledged. I'll be on standby and will DM Front Desk the lactation code and locker instructions.
Mike Reynolds: All set from my side. I'll ping here if stipend receipts are submitted.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team — seems covered. I'll add a quick note to the candidate doc with the lactation room location and quiet-room etiquette. :heart:
